title: [Bug]: T2 macsec tests fail to gather minigraph facts
author: liamkearney-msft
body:
### Issue Description

macsec tests when run on T2 chassis fail with a runtime exception, due to tbinfo not being passed into a `get_extended_minigraph_facts()` call.

### Results you see

Runtime error during test startup

### Results you expected to see

the test starts properly
